      contextRef="Duration_1_30_2022_To_1_28_2023_wk1ASltT30uwk71RXhfJNQ"
      id="Tb_0WKEN6UcpkOt9z1MkXzPmw">&lt;table style="border-collapse:collapse;border:0;"&gt;&lt;tr&gt;&lt;td style="vertical-align:text-top;white-space:nowrap;width:18pt;padding:0pt;"&gt;&lt;p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:10pt;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;"&gt;&lt;b style="font-weight:bold;"&gt;16.&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td style="padding:0pt;"&gt;&lt;p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:10pt;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;"&gt;&lt;b style="font-family:'TimesNewRomanPS-BoldMT';font-weight:bold;"&gt;PROPOSED MERGER WITH ALBERTSONS COMPANIES, INC.&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/table&gt;&lt;p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;"&gt;&lt;span style="visibility:hidden;"&gt;&#x200b;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:10pt;text-indent:18pt;margin:0pt;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-family:'TimesNewRomanPSMT';"&gt;As previously disclosed, on October 13, 2022, the Company entered into a merger agreement with Albertsons pursuant to which all of the outstanding shares of Albertsons common and preferred stock (on an as converted basis) automatically will be converted into the right to receive &lt;/span&gt;&lt;span style="font-family:'TimesNewRomanPSMT';"&gt;$34.10&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span style="font-family:'TimesNewRomanPSMT';"&gt; per share, subject to certain reductions described below. This price implies a total enterprise value of approximately &lt;/span&gt;&lt;span style="font-family:'TimesNewRomanPSMT';"&gt;$24,600&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span style="font-family:'TimesNewRomanPSMT';"&gt;, including the assumption of approximately &lt;/span&gt;&lt;span style="font-family:'TimesNewRomanPSMT';"&gt;$4,700&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span style="font-family:'TimesNewRomanPSMT';"&gt; of Albertsons net debt.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-family:'TimesNewRomanPSMT';visibility:hidden;"&gt;&#x200b;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:10pt;text-indent:18pt;margin:0pt;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-family:'TimesNewRomanPSMT';white-space:pre-wrap;"&gt;In connection with obtaining the requisite regulatory clearance necessary to consummate the transaction, the Company and Albertsons expect to make store divestitures. Subject to the outcome of the divestiture process and as described in the merger agreement, Albertsons is prepared to establish an Albertsons subsidiary (&#x201c;SpinCo&#x201d;). SpinCo would be spun-off to Albertsons shareholders immediately prior to the closing of the merger and operate as a standalone public company. The Company and Albertsons have agreed to work together to determine which stores, if any, would comprise SpinCo, as well as the pro forma capitalization of SpinCo.  &lt;/span&gt;&lt;span style="font-family:'TimesNewRomanPSMT';"&gt;The per share cash purchase price of &lt;/span&gt;&lt;span style="font-family:'TimesNewRomanPSMT';"&gt;$34.10&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span style="font-family:'TimesNewRomanPSMT';"&gt; payable to Albertsons shareholders in the merger would be reduced by an amount equal to (i) &lt;/span&gt;&lt;span style="font-family:'TimesNewRomanPSMT';"&gt;$6.85&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span style="font-family:'TimesNewRomanPSMT';"&gt;, which is the per share amount of a special pre-closing cash dividend that was paid on January 20, 2023 to Albertsons shareholders of record as of October 24, 2022 plus (ii) &lt;/span&gt;&lt;span style="font-family:'TimesNewRomanPSMT';"&gt;three&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span style="font-family:'TimesNewRomanPSMT';white-space:pre-wrap;"&gt; times the four-wall adjusted EBITDA for the stores contributed to SpinCo., if any, divided by the number of shares of Albertsons common stock (including shares of Albertsons common stock issuable upon conversion of Albertsons preferred stock) outstanding as of the record date for the spin-off.  The Company and Albertsons continue to work to determine whether any stores will be contributed to SpinCo.  The current adjusted per share cash purchase price is expected to be &lt;/span&gt;&lt;span style="font-family:'TimesNewRomanPSMT';"&gt;$27.25&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span style="font-family:'TimesNewRomanPSMT';"&gt;, pending determination of any required adjustments for SpinCo.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-family:'TimesNewRomanPSMT';visibility:hidden;"&gt;&#x200b;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:10pt;text-indent:18pt;margin:0pt;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-family:'TimesNewRomanPSMT';"&gt;In connection with the merger agreement, on October 13, 2022, the Company entered into a commitment letter with certain lenders pursuant to which the lenders have committed to provide a &lt;/span&gt;&lt;span style="font-family:'TimesNewRomanPSMT';"&gt;$17,400&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span style="font-family:'TimesNewRomanPSMT';"&gt; senior unsecured bridge term loan facility, which, if entered into, would mature &lt;/span&gt;&lt;span style="font-family:'TimesNewRomanPSMT';"&gt;364 days&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span style="font-family:'TimesNewRomanPSMT';"&gt; after the closing date of the merger. The commitments are intended to be drawn to finance the merger with Albertsons only to the extent the Company does not arrange for alternative financing prior to closing. As alternative financing for the merger is secured, the commitments with respect to the bridge term loan facility under the commitment letter will be reduced. Upfront fees with respect to the bridge term loan facility are included in &#x201c;Financing fees paid&#x201d; in the Company&#x2019;s Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows and will be recognized as operating, general and administrative expense in the Company&#x2019;s Consolidated Statements of Operations over the commitment period.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-family:'TimesNewRomanPSMT';visibility:hidden;"&gt;&#x200b;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:10pt;text-indent:18pt;margin:0pt;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-family:'TimesNewRomanPSMT';"&gt;On November 9, 2022, the Company executed a term loan credit agreement with certain lenders pursuant to which the lenders committed to provide, contingent upon the completion of the merger with Albertsons and certain other customary conditions to funding, (1) senior unsecured term loans in an aggregate principal amount of &lt;/span&gt;&lt;span style="font-family:'TimesNewRomanPSMT';"&gt;$3,000&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span style="font-family:'TimesNewRomanPSMT';"&gt; maturing on the third anniversary of the merger closing date and (2) senior unsecured term loans in an aggregate principal amount of &lt;/span&gt;&lt;span style="font-family:'TimesNewRomanPSMT';"&gt;$1,750&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span style="font-family:'TimesNewRomanPSMT';"&gt; maturing on the date that is 18 months after the merger closing date (collectively, the &#x201c;Term Loan Facilities&#x201d;). Borrowings under the Term Loan Facilities will be used to pay a portion of the consideration and other amounts payable in connection with the merger with Albertsons. The entry into the term loan credit agreement reduces the commitments under the Company&#x2019;s &lt;/span&gt;&lt;span style="font-family:'TimesNewRomanPSMT';"&gt;$17,400&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span style="font-family:'TimesNewRomanPSMT';"&gt; bridge facility commitment by &lt;/span&gt;&lt;span style="font-family:'TimesNewRomanPSMT';"&gt;$4,750&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span style="font-family:'TimesNewRomanPSMT';"&gt;. Borrowings under the Term Loan Facilities will bear interest at rates that vary based on the type of loan and the Company&#x2019;s debt rating. In addition to the sources of financing described above, the Company expects to finance the transaction with senior notes issuances, borrowings under its commercial paper program, bank credit facility capacity and cash on hand.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-family:'TimesNewRomanPSMT';visibility:hidden;"&gt;&#x200b;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p style="font-family:'Times New Roman','Times','serif';font-size:10pt;text-indent:18pt;margin:0pt;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-family:'TimesNewRomanPSMT';"&gt;The agreement provides for certain termination rights for the Company and Albertsons, including if the closing does not occur on or prior to January 13, 2024 (the &#x201c;Outside Date&#x201d;), provided that the Outside Date may be extended by either party for up to &lt;/span&gt;&lt;span style="font-family:'TimesNewRomanPSMT';"&gt;270 days&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span style="font-family:'TimesNewRomanPSMT';"&gt; in the aggregate. The Company will be obligated to pay a termination fee of &lt;/span&gt;&lt;span style="font-family:'TimesNewRomanPSMT';"&gt;$600&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span style="font-family:'TimesNewRomanPSMT';"&gt; if the merger agreement is terminated by either party in connection with the occurrence of the Outside Date, and, at the time of such termination, all closing conditions other than regulatory approval have been satisfied. The transaction is expected to close in early 2024, subject to the receipt of required regulatory clearance and other customary closing conditions.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;</us-gaap:BusinessCombinationDisclosureTextBlock>
